description: Start a new registration: creates the business (as a draft) with the name the user wants to register, in the workspace they're in (pass `workspace` only when they ask for the other one). Pass `line_of_business` too: the exact CAC entry you used for the name check (say which, so they can change it): it's saved with the draft. A personal registration needs a verified WhatsApp number: without one it returns whatsapp_unverified (request_whatsapp_verification sets it up).

line_of_business.description: Optional: the exact CAC line-of-business entry used for the name check.

name.description: The business name they want to register.

name: create_business
title: Start a business registration
